labels.name: type:core
labels.description: Core module - can be depended on by any other module

labels.name: type:database
labels.description: Database module - can only be depended on by platforms (except devDependencies)

labels.name: type:extension
labels.description: Extension module - can depend on core and other extensions, can be depended on by extensions and platforms

labels.name: type:platform
labels.description: Platform module - top level, nothing can depend on this

labels.name: layer:backend
labels.description: Backend layer - can depend on backend and shared layers

labels.name: layer:frontend
labels.description: Frontend layer - can depend on frontend and shared layers

labels.name: layer:shared
labels.description: Shared layer - can only depend on shared layer

labels.name: capability:entities
labels.description: Contains entity definitions and CRUD operations

labels.name: capability:workflows
labels.description: Contains workflow definitions and execution logic

labels.name: capability:ui
labels.description: Contains UI components and frontend interfaces
